notes.title: Patch Notes v1.0.1
notes.notes:
[b]New Equipment[/b]
[list]
[*] Fiber Optic Cable: Adds a 4th option when picking upgrades. If you've already completed the requirements to unlock this equipment, it will become available after your next run (including abandoned runs).
[/list]
[b]General[/b]
[list]
[*] You can now reinstall weapons destroyed by Specializer. After gaining additional weapon slots, your original weapons will appear in the upgrade rotation at their previous level.
[*] The Completionist legendary now uses the phrase "EXP orb" to be consistent with other text in the game
[*] Added extra text to clarify that "on heal" abilities trigger even when healing at full HP
[*] The final Spread Invert upgrade now says "+2 bullets to all abilities" in order to better reflect what it actually does. Previously, it stated it only applied to weapons.
[*] Updated gold bonus on stage reward screen to say "challenge reward" in order to better reflect that the gold is coming from completed challenges
[/list]
[b]Balance[/b]
[list]
[*] Assassin Protocol: No longer adds 1s cooldown
[*] Weapon Mount: Now gives +10% EXP
[*] Rubber Plating: No longer reduces the player’s outgoing crash damage
[*] Attribute Wall: Increased cooldown/fire rate bonus per shield from 1% to 1.5%
[*] Chakram: Increased starting size
[/list]
[b]Bug fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where Chakram would lag behind the player when playing at less than 120 FPS
[*] Fixed a similar issue where some Stage 2 enemies would form a tighter circle than intended depending on framerate
[*] The Max FPS setting now properly takes affect when restarting the game
[*] Certain Stage 3 enemies can no longer be knocked off the screen
[*] Killing an enemy offscreen will no longer trigger Completionist damage due to the EXP spawning offscreen
[*] EXP from equipment and miniboss loot is no longer destroyed by leaving the screen
[*] Fixed an issue where fashion items dropped more frequently than intended
[/list]

notes.title: Available Now
notes.notes:
Greetings star pilots! It's been a long journey, but we're finally here.

[h2]Release Highlights[/h2]
[b]Asteroid Launcher[/b]
This new weapon fires a massive, physical projectile that deals crash damage. Master this weapon to unlock a legendary capable of adding crash damage to any weapon (and yes, bullets trigger Explosive Armor).

[b]Virus Damage[/b]
A new virus damage type enables high-risk, high-reward builds. Virus weapons and passives drain your own health in exchange for massive buffs. Don't go too deep into virus upgrades until your healing can keep up.

[b]Shields[/b]
Shields completely block damage, and grant bonuses while you remain untouched. Push your bullet hell skills to the limit, as careful dodging is the way to maintain your shields and maximize this build.

[b]Domain of the Revenant[/b]
New enemies and bosses are waiting on the research planet of Cobalt Syntharia. The rebel army now possess advanced revenant rebirth drives. Watch out for invincible rebel ships, raised from the dead by a Spectromancer. Kill the source, and they all die.

[b]Fashion[/b]
Deck out your ship in ultra-rare fashion equipment, as well many new ship bodies and engine trails. Fashion equipment is only available to players who complete the toughest challenges.

[b]Challenges[/b]
Master the game by completing a new series of challenges, on both stages and loadouts. The harder ones are linked directly to Steam achievements. Can you beat the Stage 1 boss in 7 seconds? Probably not.

[h2]Patch Notes v1.0.0[/h2]
[b]General[/b]
[list]
[*] Steam achievements are in
[*] New content everywhere
[*] Additional challenges have been added to the loadouts included in the demo
[*] The game will pause when the player's gamepad disconnects
[*] You can know have more than 9999 gold
[*] Leveling up after maxing out all upgrades will now have crypto gold as the first option
[*] The end-of-stage battle report will now show the total gold earned from boss loot
[/list]
[b]Balance[/b]
[list]
[*] Stage 1 has a few more moments where you feel like you're totally going to die
[*] Codex now also grants +1 weapon slot
[*] Unstable Encyclopedia: Decreased the heal rate from 5% to 3%
[*] Titanium Plating: Increased cooldown bonus from 1% to 2%
[*] Explosive Armor: Reduced the fully upgraded damage multiplier from 125% to 54%
[*] Explosive Armor: Reduced the bullet upgrades from 2 to 1
[*] Spread Needle/Spread Invert: Reduce the fully upgraded cooldown multiplier from 21% to 10%
[*] Dark Matter Field: Increased pierce from 3 to 5
[*] Heatseeker Prime: Decreased the fully upgraded damage multiplier from 96% to 68%
[/list]
[b]Bug fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the level up window would show incorrect text
[*] Switching tabs on the shop screen will now properly scroll to the top of the new tab's item list
[*] EXP orbs will no longer have trails that stretch across the screen
[*] Leveling up and collecting boss loot in the same frame will no longer cancel each other out
[*] The EXP bar on the UI now properly resets after leveling up
[*] Fixed an issue where a single level up would trigger the upgrade window two or three times
[*] Spawning enemies will no longer suffer from uncontrollable twitching shortly after they appear
[*] Background buildings are no longer floating above the ground on low graphics settings
[*] Fixed an issue where the cursor on the equipment menu wouldn't loop properly
[/list]
[h2]What's next?[/h2]
First up will be bug fixes and balance. Share your OP builds and keep the bug reports coming.
Next will be taking a look at a highly requested feature: local co-op. No promises yet, as I need to make sure multiplayer works well in a game like this.

If you like the game, and want to see more updates, [b][i]please leave a review[/i][/b]. It helps bring more visibility and let other players know this is a game worth playing. Thanks everyone and enjoy the game!

notes.title: Solar Survivors launches on April 16
notes.notes:
Greetings star pilots. The High Priests of Eden have decreed that Solar Survivors shall launch on April 16th. Become the ultimate faithkeeper you were meant to be, and destroy the rebel army with overwhelming firepower and OP builds.

I'm excited to finally share the 1.0 release with everyone! And don't worry, all save data from the demo will transfer over automatically. I'll share full patch notes on release day, but look forward to new content, challenges, and crazy legendaries.

Thanks to everyone who gave feedback, posted videos, streamed on twitch, and just played the game in generally. See you in two weeks.

Cheers,
Box

notes.title: Patch Notes v0.5.1
notes.notes:
[b]Balance[/b]
[list]
[*] Stage 1: Laser mini-bosses will now follow the player (same as in the beta). Having them stay still just wasn't as interesting.
[*] Stage 1: Added 2 more mini-bosses. The goal is to give new players more chances at legendary loot. Newer players tended to avoid the bosses and let them time out, and were missing out on a core game mechanic by not getting the boss drops.
[*] Stage 1: Added a few more moments where you feel like you're totally going to die
[*] Stage 1: The stage boss has a new strategy: wiggle up and down slightly. This masterful counters the player's preferred strategy of standing perfectly still in the tiny gap between lasers.
[*] Codex: Increased EXP gain from 40% to 50%
[*] Unstable Encyclopedia: Reduced EXP by half, size from 500% to 400%, and damage from 250 to 200
[/list]
[b]General[/b]
[list]
[*] Updated the DPS calculation. For the statisticians reading this and wondering how DPS can be calculated multiple ways, consider this example: a bullet with 10 damage hits an enemy with 1 hp. Previous system would count this as 10 damage, but the new system counts this as 1.
[*] Additional visual polish
[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where increasing legendary drop rate actually decreased drop rate
[*] EXP can no longer spawn partially off-screen
[/list]

notes.title: Return to Kedoshim
notes.notes:
Stage 1 is back! Return to the sands of Kedoshim, not seen since ancient times (the beta a few months ago). Travel to this desert planet, known for its anti-matter mines, in order to purify the rebel army.

[h3]Patch Notes v0.5[/h3]
[b]New content[/b]
[list]
[*] Stage 1 is back with improved level and boss design.
[*] The Codex loadout has been added. It focuses on EXP manipulation and triggering powerful effects on level up. Unlock a new passive, a legendary, and equipment.
[*] Add more equipment to your star fighter's motherboard with an additional, unlockable PCIe slot.
[/list]
[b]General[/b]
[list]
[*] Stage 2 has been reduced from 16 to 15 minutes to match Stage 1.
[*] Stage 2 now needs to be unlocked, either by clearing Stage 1 or earning enough Stage EXP to reach bonus level 5.
[*] Minibosses will now get bored and slowly walk away. The intent is to make the game easier for defensive builds and playstyles. Previously, if you don't burst down a miniboss, they'll stick on the screen for the rest of time and become overwhelming. Now, they'll eventually leave the screen but won't drop any loot.
[*] Items in the shop you can't afford are now sorted below items you can afford.
[/list]
[b]Balance[/b]
[list]
[*] Reduced the overall DPS of the Spread weapons, but improved the final upgrade of Spread Invert.
[*] Doubled the base damage of Heatseeker Omega. This is one of my favorite items - setting up combos to proc the effect as often as possible feels great, but is actually trash DPS. This should fix that.
[/list]

notes.title: Big update! New items and mechanics
notes.notes:

notes.title: Demo Release
notes.notes:
Greetings pilots. Today we enter a new stage of the game's development - demo time. Unlike the previous beta events, the demo will be available to play at any time.

[h3]How to participate?[/h3]
Visit the store page and click the download button. Done.

If you played the beta, the demo will be a separate app.

[h3]What's new?[/h3]
[b]Permanent Progression[/b]
Your save file will carry over to the full game.

Some of the unlocks and challenges have been reworked since the last beta. For the grind enjoyers, crypto gold is capped at 9999. Don't go too crazy.

[b]Fashion[/b]
Customize your ship and engine trail. Earn new outfits by completing runs.

[b]Full Gamepad Support[/b]
Use a gamepad everywhere. And for the hardcore shmup fans, joystick should work too. No more under construction beta menus that require a mouse.

[b]Goodbye Stage 1[/b]
The desert stage available during beta is no longer playable. Don't worry! It will be back with redesigned enemy encounters.

[b]Lore and Flavor Text[/b]
Learn the dark history of a galaxy rapidly conquered by the Theocracy of Eden. Serve your god-emperors as a Faithkeeper, the highest level of star pilot.

[h3]How to give feedback?[/h3]
Join us on [url=https://discord.gg/VND54XHfXn]Discord[/url]. Feedback is welcome and improves the game!

notes.title: Beta Event #2
notes.notes:
A beta event emerges from a nearby nebula, and it’s packed with features. This beta focuses on long-term progression systems, improved stage design, and an ability overhaul.

[h3]How to participate?[/h3]
Click the Request Access button on the store page and you're good. If you request access before the official start date, Steam will email you when the beta is available.

If you played the first beta event, you're already registered.

[h3]What's new?[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43576671/624125103072490b7b10dc6acb9ca17e07ecf718.png[/img]

[b]Buy, Equip, Unlock[/b]
Earn crypto gold (the currency of the future), and use it to buy equipment and earn new abilities. Complete challenges to unlock new items to purchase.

[b]New Stage: Temple of the Old Gods[/b]
Fight a new set of enemies amongst a backdrop of ancient alien temples and volcanic rock. This new stage incorporates a lot of player feedback and follows a different approach to enemy design.

The desert stage from Beta #1 is still available for comparison. Which one do you prefer?

[b]Stage Bonus Level[/b]
Playing a stage now earns Stage EXP that provides bonuses for future runs.

[b]New Abilities and Loadouts[/b]
Nearly every ability from Beta #1 has been revamped. What's the new best build?

The crowd-favorite Dark Matter Field was actually horribly bugged. It had an unlimited pierce stat and a damage radius far bigger than the graphic showed. Expect it to be less OP, but don't worry, there's a new set of dark matter abilities to keep the destruction going.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43576671/c2c39c165c1c5dc6845a7023b729e450a6d260f6.png[/img]

[h3]How to give feedback?[/h3]
The [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2302280/]Playtest Community[/url] will be live with the next beta. Drop your feedback there and help improve the game.

[h3]When can I play?[/h3]
August 11 - 14

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43576671/c28daa6e76bcc55033b16755511de403e8cd097e.png[/img]

notes.title: Beta Event
notes.notes:
The week-long Beta Event is here. Try a variety of weapon combos and get strong enough to beat the boss. What's your best build?

[h3]How to participate?[/h3]
Click the Request Access button on the store page and you're good. If you request access before the official start date, Steam will email you when the beta is available.

[h3]What will I find?[/h3]
[i]Incredible gameplay[/i]. And if you don't find that, please leave feedback so the game can become incredible.

[h3]What's included in the beta?[/h3]
1 stage, 5 weapons, 9 upgrades, and 10 legendary upgrades that re-define your build and mix up the playstyle between runs.

Each run starts by picking 1 of 4 loadouts.

[h3]Loadouts[/h3]
[b]Blaster[/b]
Fire bullets directly in front you. Feels more like a traditional shmup. This weapon is powerful, but needs precision.

[b]Heatseeker[/b]
Fill the screen with homing bullets. Each time you get damaged or defeat an enemy, fire more homing bullets. Less precision needed for this loadout, but good tactics are a must.

[b]Dark Matter Field[/b]
Purposefully ram into enemies and deal AoE damage to anything nearby. With the right upgrades, smashing into weaker enemies can even heal you.

[b]Spread[/b]
A pair of linked weapons. Upgrading one automatically shares the upgrade to the other. Good luck focusing the power, as these bullets fire in a wide arc.

[h3]What's not included?[/h3]
The progression system. In the full game, each run will earn you crypto-gold and a chance at loot. These will provide permanent upgrades to customize your fighter. You'll also be able to get clothes for your space ship.

Also more stages, more weapons, more upgrades, more content in general.

[h3]How to participate?[/h3]
That was already covered. Question #1.
